sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Firebase Sessions from collecting usage data.
Removes banner, interstitial, app open and podcast audio ads, the launch promo video and the ad consent form.
Unlocks RJ Premium downloads, high quality audio, lyrics, unlimited skips and song selection, and hides ads. Requires a signed-in account.
